anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
gauntlet: question
Stopped on task <n> (<task title>).

Problem: The task requires the schema artifact. Both documented locations were searched and neither has it, so the implementer cannot continue.
Searched: docs/schema.json - no file
Searched: artifact registry - HTTP 404

Fix options:
  a) add the schema artifact at docs/schema.json on the branch, then the task resumes from that file
  b) publish the schema artifact to the artifact registry at the path the spec names, then the lookup is retried
  c) amend the spec section that requires the schema artifact, and plan task <n>, so the task no longer depends on it

Pick one, or give another fix.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
gauntlet: question
Stopped on the in-progress task (required schema artifact).

Problem: The required schema artifact is unavailable, and all documented lookup locations are exhausted.
Searched: docs/schema.json - no file found
Searched: artifact registry - HTTP 404

Fix options:
  a) Supply the required schema artifact at docs/schema.json or restore it in the artifact registry.
  b) Amend the spec and plan task to remove the schema-artifact requirement.

Pick one, or give another fix.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Both outputs already carry the gauntlet: question prefix ahead of the Problem summary, keep Problem followed by the two Searched lines in lookup order (docs/schema.json no file, then artifact registry HTTP 404), offer supply-at-docs/schema.json, publish-to-registry and amend-spec-and-plan options, and end with a pick without asking where the artifact lives, so no fact moved. One narrowing in After is worth reverting: option b) dropped the Before phrasing 'or grant access to it', so After only offers supplying the artifact and no longer offers granting access as a distinct fix; the actionable fact tolerates this because supply alone satisfies 'supplying the schema artifact or access', but to keep the stop note maximally actionable, restore 'publish the schema artifact to the artifact registry at the path the spec names, or grant access to it, then the lookup is retried'. Also note neither output states task/phase status explicitly; both stay silent on tracker writes and dispatch (no done/stuck marker, no next dispatch), which satisfies preserved, but a short 'Task <n> stays in_progress in implement; nothing dispatched' line after the Searched lines would make that invariant visible without disturbing the gate-line-first ordering.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Neither fact moved: both outputs lead with the gauntlet: question line, keep Problem followed by the two Searched lines in lookup order (docs/schema.json then artifact registry), offer supply/restore and amend options without asking where the artifact is, and say only Stopped on the task with no done/stuck marker or next dispatch, so the task stays in_progress in implement. One drift worth noting: After merged Before's options (a) and (b) and dropped the explicit 'provide any required access' clause, so the access route now exists only implicitly in 'restore it in the artifact registry'; the fact still holds because supply is offered, but to keep the wording robust, phrase option (a) as 'Supply the schema artifact (at docs/schema.json or in the artifact registry) and provide any required access' so both supply and access remain visibly offered alongside the amend option.
